description: Read connected projects, including cloned upstream references. Use known IDs directly; list with query filters project names/IDs (start/limit pages, list limit<=100). connections lists source/runtime adapter metadata; compatibility with project checks actual readable source and declared runtime contracts. Source-ready is not an installed/running application or business account. Paths are relative to the selected root: package.json in root=frontend; clones normally use root=source. Use search, numbered read, tree, git and instructions as needed. Source access cannot apply changes or execute clone commands.
